one_to_two_kinematics [C].note: leading-order masses. phi -> q q: m_phi/(2 m_q) <= 0.946, closed at every T. phi -> D D is kinematically open for T >~ 3 T_c (m_D grows only with Pi_D = 2.6e-4), but at phi = 0 there is no cubic vertex (exact Z2): the decay exists only through the coherent background itself (h_D^2 phi_c phi D D), i.e. at second order in phi_c. It adds damping while phi_c is large and is negligible (ratio below) against the linear 2<->2 width; it is not credited.
